sentences.text: Petugas teater menegur penonton yang meludah sembarangan di tangga gedung.
sentences.en: The theater staff scolded an audience member who spat carelessly on the building's stairs.
sentences.ko: 극장 직원이 건물 계단에 함부로 침을 뱉은 관객을 꾸짖었어요.

sentences.text: Ayu menegur anak-anak yang meludah ke sungai di bawah desa.
sentences.en: Ayu scolds the children who spit into the river below the village.
sentences.ko: 아유는 마을 아래 강에 침을 뱉는 아이들을 꾸짖어요.

sentences.text: Eko meminta penonton tidak mengotori kursi dengan sisa makanan.
sentences.en: Eko asks the audience not to dirty the seats with leftover food.
sentences.ko: 에코는 관객들에게 남은 음식으로 좌석을 더럽히지 말라고 부탁해요.

sentences.text: Warga desa sepakat tidak mengotori mata air dengan sampah plastik.
sentences.en: The villagers agreed not to pollute the spring with plastic waste.
sentences.ko: 마을 사람들은 샘물을 플라스틱 쓰레기로 더럽히지 않기로 했어요.

sentences.text: Para kritikus memuji penampilan cemerlang aktris muda itu.
sentences.en: The critics praised the young actress's brilliant performance.
sentences.ko: 비평가들은 그 젊은 여배우의 빛나는 연기를 칭찬했어요.

sentences.text: Dari puncak bukit, Ayu melihat bintang yang cemerlang di langit malam.
sentences.en: From the top of the hill, Ayu sees brilliant stars in the night sky.
sentences.ko: 언덕 꼭대기에서 아유는 밤하늘의 빛나는 별을 봐요.

sentences.text: Dalam drama itu, sang raja terlalu memanjakan putranya sampai lupa tugas.
sentences.en: In the play, the king spoils his son so much that he forgets his duties.
sentences.ko: 그 연극에서 왕은 아들을 너무 응석받이로 키워 자기 임무를 잊어요.

sentences.text: Nenek Ayu suka memanjakan cucu-cucunya dengan kue singkong.
sentences.en: Ayu's grandmother likes to spoil her grandchildren with cassava cakes.
sentences.ko: 아유의 할머니는 손주들에게 카사바 과자를 해 주며 귀여워해요.

sentences.text: Eko tidak keberatan kalau penonton mengkritik naskah barunya.
sentences.en: Eko doesn't mind if the audience criticizes his new script.
sentences.ko: 에코는 관객이 새 대본을 비판해도 개의치 않아요.

sentences.text: Beberapa warga mengkritik kepala desa karena jalan menuju kebun belum diperbaiki.
sentences.en: Some residents criticized the village head because the road to the gardens hasn't been repaired.
sentences.ko: 몇몇 주민은 밭으로 가는 길을 아직 안 고쳤다고 이장을 비판했어요.

sentences.text: Sutradara mengutip puisi lama di awal pertunjukan.
sentences.en: The director quoted an old poem at the start of the show.
sentences.ko: 연출가는 공연 첫머리에 옛 시를 인용했어요.

sentences.text: Di rapat desa, Ayu mengutip nasihat kakeknya tentang menjaga hutan.
sentences.en: At the village meeting, Ayu quotes her grandfather's advice on protecting the forest.
sentences.ko: 마을 회의에서 아유는 숲을 지키라는 할아버지의 조언을 인용해요.

sentences.text: Sebelum tirai dibuka, Eko merapikan kostum para pemain.
sentences.en: Before the curtain opens, Eko tidies the actors' costumes.
sentences.ko: 막이 오르기 전에 에코는 배우들의 의상을 매만져요.

sentences.text: Setiap pagi Ayu merapikan tumpukan kayu bakar di samping rumah.
sentences.en: Every morning Ayu tidies the pile of firewood beside the house.
sentences.ko: 아유는 매일 아침 집 옆의 장작 더미를 정리해요.

sentences.text: Tepuk tangan penonton menguatkan semangat para pemain baru.
sentences.en: The audience's applause boosted the new actors' spirits.
sentences.ko: 관객의 박수가 신인 배우들에게 힘을 북돋아 줬어요.

sentences.text: Warga menanam bambu untuk menguatkan tanah di lereng yang rawan longsor.
sentences.en: The villagers plant bamboo to strengthen the soil on slopes prone to landslides.
sentences.ko: 주민들은 산사태가 잦은 비탈의 흙을 다지려고 대나무를 심어요.

sentences.text: Di panggung belakang ada pohon kerdil dalam pot untuk dekorasi.
sentences.en: Backstage there is a dwarf tree in a pot for decoration.
sentences.ko: 무대 뒤에는 장식용 분재 나무가 있어요.

sentences.text: Di puncak gunung hanya tumbuh pohon-pohon kerdil karena anginnya kencang.
sentences.en: Only stunted trees grow on the mountaintop because the wind is strong.
sentences.ko: 바람이 세서 산꼭대기에는 키 작은 나무만 자라요.

sentences.text: Tokoh preman dalam drama itu menggertak pedagang kecil di pasar.
sentences.en: The thug character in the play intimidates small traders at the market.
sentences.ko: 그 연극의 깡패 역은 시장의 작은 상인들을 위협해요.

sentences.text: Ayu tidak takut walau anak tetangga mencoba menggertak dia dengan cerita hantu.
sentences.en: Ayu isn't scared even though the neighbor's kid tries to frighten her with ghost stories.
sentences.ko: 이웃집 아이가 귀신 이야기로 겁을 주려 해도 아유는 무서워하지 않아요.

sentences.text: Banyak tiket terbuang karena pertunjukan malam dibatalkan.
sentences.en: Many tickets went to waste because the evening show was canceled.
sentences.ko: 저녁 공연이 취소돼서 표가 많이 버려졌어요.

sentences.text: Banyak sayur terbuang karena truk pengangkut tidak datang minggu ini.
sentences.en: A lot of vegetables went to waste because the transport truck didn't come this week.
sentences.ko: 이번 주에 운반 트럭이 안 와서 채소가 많이 버려졌어요.

sentences.text: Anjing penjaga gedung tiba-tiba menggonggong saat adegan paling sunyi.
sentences.en: The building's guard dog suddenly barked during the quietest scene.
sentences.ko: 건물 경비견이 가장 조용한 장면에서 갑자기 짖었어요.

sentences.text: Anjing Ayu selalu menggonggong kalau ada orang asing masuk desa.
sentences.en: Ayu's dog always barks when a stranger enters the village.
sentences.ko: 아유의 개는 낯선 사람이 마을에 들어오면 늘 짖어요.

sentences.text: Kostum sang ratu berkilau di bawah lampu sorot.
sentences.en: The queen's costume sparkles under the spotlight.
sentences.ko: 여왕의 의상이 조명 아래에서 반짝여요.

sentences.text: Embun pagi berkilau di daun-daun teh di belakang rumah Ayu.
sentences.en: The morning dew sparkles on the tea leaves behind Ayu's house.
sentences.ko: 아침 이슬이 아유네 집 뒤 찻잎 위에서 반짝여요.

sentences.text: Lakon itu bercerita tentang pekerja yang berani melawan atasan yang melecehkan karyawan.
sentences.en: The play tells of a worker who dares to stand up to a boss who harasses employees.
sentences.ko: 그 연극은 직원들을 괴롭히는 상사에게 맞서는 노동자 이야기예요.

sentences.text: Kepala desa mengingatkan bahwa melecehkan pendatang adalah perbuatan yang memalukan.
sentences.en: The village head reminds everyone that harassing newcomers is a shameful act.
sentences.ko: 이장은 외지인을 괴롭히는 건 부끄러운 짓이라고 일깨워요.

sentences.text: Lantai panggung jadi licin setelah adegan hujan buatan.
sentences.en: The stage floor became slippery after the artificial rain scene.
sentences.ko: 인공 비 장면이 끝나자 무대 바닥이 미끄러워졌어요.

sentences.text: Setelah hujan, jalan setapak ke kebun Ayu menjadi licin.
sentences.en: After the rain, the footpath to Ayu's garden becomes slippery.
sentences.ko: 비가 그치면 아유네 밭으로 가는 오솔길이 미끄러워져요.

sentences.text: Penonton ikut terbawa suasana sampai ada yang menangis.
sentences.en: The audience got carried away by the mood, and some even cried.
sentences.ko: 관객들도 분위기에 빠져 우는 사람까지 있었어요.

sentences.text: Sandal Ayu terbawa arus saat ia menyeberangi sungai kecil.
sentences.en: Ayu's sandal was swept away by the current as she crossed the stream.
sentences.ko: 아유가 개울을 건널 때 샌들이 물살에 떠내려갔어요.

sentences.text: Salah satu adegan menampilkan dua pemuda yang bermain kriket di taman.
sentences.en: One scene shows two young men playing cricket in a park.
sentences.ko: 한 장면에서는 두 청년이 공원에서 크리켓을 해요.

sentences.text: Anak-anak desa belajar main kriket dari relawan yang datang ke sekolah.
sentences.en: The village children learned to play cricket from volunteers who came to the school.
sentences.ko: 마을 아이들은 학교에 온 봉사자들에게 크리켓을 배웠어요.

sentences.text: Teater kecil itu ingin memperbaiki citra seni panggung di mata anak muda.
sentences.en: The small theater wants to improve the image of stage art in the eyes of young people.
sentences.ko: 그 작은 극장은 젊은이들 사이에서 무대 예술의 이미지를 높이고 싶어 해요.

sentences.text: Desa Ayu ingin membangun citra sebagai desa wisata yang bersih.
sentences.en: Ayu's village wants to build an image as a clean tourist village.
sentences.ko: 아유네 마을은 깨끗한 관광 마을이라는 이미지를 만들고 싶어 해요.

sentences.text: Topeng emas di poster itu menjadi lambang kelompok teater Eko.
sentences.en: The gold mask on the poster has become the emblem of Eko's theater group.
sentences.ko: 포스터의 금빛 가면은 에코 극단의 상징이 됐어요.

sentences.text: Pohon beringin di alun-alun dianggap lambang persatuan warga.
sentences.en: The banyan tree in the square is seen as a symbol of the villagers' unity.
sentences.ko: 광장의 반얀나무는 주민 화합의 상징으로 여겨져요.

sentences.text: Penonton yang merokok di dalam gedung bisa kena denda.
sentences.en: Audience members who smoke inside the building can be fined.
sentences.ko: 건물 안에서 담배를 피우는 관객은 벌금을 낼 수 있어요.

sentences.text: Siapa pun yang menebang pohon di hutan lindung harus membayar denda.
sentences.en: Anyone who cuts down trees in the protected forest must pay a fine.
sentences.ko: 보호림에서 나무를 베는 사람은 누구든 벌금을 내야 해요.

sentences.text: Lakon terbaru Eko berkisah tentang tiga saudara yang bertengkar soal harta waris.
sentences.en: Eko's latest play is about three siblings who quarrel over an inheritance.
sentences.ko: 에코의 새 연극은 유산 문제로 다투는 세 형제 이야기예요.

sentences.text: Ayu adalah ahli waris sawah terasering milik kakeknya.
sentences.en: Ayu is the heir to her grandfather's terraced rice fields.
sentences.ko: 아유는 할아버지의 계단식 논을 물려받을 상속인이에요.

sentences.text: Bagi Eko, teater bisa membawa pencerahan bagi masyarakat.
sentences.en: For Eko, theater can bring enlightenment to society.
sentences.ko: 에코에게 연극은 사회에 깨달음을 줄 수 있는 것이에요.

sentences.text: Penyuluh pertanian membawa pencerahan soal cara menanam kopi yang lebih baik.
sentences.en: The agricultural extension worker brought new insight on better ways to grow coffee.
sentences.ko: 농업 지도사가 커피를 더 잘 기르는 방법에 대해 새로운 깨우침을 줬어요.

sentences.text: Drama sejarah itu menggambarkan siksaan yang dialami para tahanan zaman penjajahan.
sentences.en: The historical drama depicts the torment prisoners suffered in colonial times.
sentences.ko: 그 역사극은 식민지 시대 수감자들이 겪은 고통을 그려요.

sentences.text: Bagi Ayu, mendaki jalan curam setiap hari bukan siksaan, melainkan olahraga.
sentences.en: For Ayu, climbing the steep road every day isn't torture but exercise.
sentences.ko: 아유에게 매일 가파른 길을 오르는 건 고문이 아니라 운동이에요.

sentences.text: Naskah Eko terinspirasi dari demonstrasi mahasiswa di masa lalu.
sentences.en: Eko's script was inspired by student demonstrations of the past.
sentences.ko: 에코의 대본은 과거 학생 시위에서 영감을 받았어요.

sentences.text: Penyuluh kesehatan memberi demonstrasi cara mencuci tangan yang benar di balai desa.
sentences.en: A health worker gave a demonstration of proper handwashing at the village hall.
sentences.ko: 보건 요원이 마을 회관에서 올바른 손 씻기 시범을 보였어요.

sentences.text: Sebelum pentas, ada pengenalan singkat tentang para pemain.
sentences.en: Before the show, there is a short introduction of the actors.
sentences.ko: 공연 전에 배우들을 짧게 소개하는 시간이 있어요.

sentences.text: Sekolah desa mengadakan masa pengenalan lingkungan untuk murid baru.
sentences.en: The village school holds an orientation period for new students.
sentences.ko: 마을 학교는 신입생을 위해 환경 적응 기간을 열어요.

sentences.text: Seorang pengacara dalam drama itu membacakan ayat kedua dari pasal undang-undang.
sentences.en: A lawyer in the play reads out the second paragraph of an article of the law.
sentences.ko: 연극 속 변호사가 법조문 제2항을 읽어요.

sentences.text: Kepala desa membacakan ayat dalam peraturan desa tentang pembagian air.
sentences.en: The village head reads out a clause in the village regulation on water sharing.
sentences.ko: 이장은 물 배분에 관한 마을 규정의 조항을 읽어요.

sentences.text: Setelah pertunjukan ada perdebatan seru antara penonton dan sutradara.
sentences.en: After the show there was a lively debate between the audience and the director.
sentences.ko: 공연이 끝난 뒤 관객과 연출가 사이에 뜨거운 토론이 있었어요.

sentences.text: Rapat desa diwarnai perdebatan soal letak pasar baru.
sentences.en: The village meeting was marked by debate over where to put the new market.
sentences.ko: 마을 회의에서는 새 시장 위치를 두고 논쟁이 벌어졌어요.

sentences.text: Kelompok teater Eko bergabung dengan federasi teater nasional.
sentences.en: Eko's theater group joined the national theater federation.
sentences.ko: 에코의 극단은 전국 연극 연맹에 가입했어요.

sentences.text: Kelompok tani desa itu kini menjadi anggota federasi petani kopi.
sentences.en: The village farmers' group is now a member of the coffee farmers' federation.
sentences.ko: 그 마을 농민 모임은 이제 커피 농민 연합의 회원이에요.

sentences.text: Hasil penjualan tiket malam itu disumbangkan untuk kesejahteraan seniman tua.
sentences.en: That night's ticket sales were donated for the welfare of elderly artists.
sentences.ko: 그날 밤 표 판매 수익은 원로 예술인들의 복지에 기부됐어요.

sentences.text: Koperasi desa didirikan untuk meningkatkan kesejahteraan para petani.
sentences.en: The village cooperative was founded to improve the farmers' welfare.
sentences.ko: 마을 협동조합은 농민들의 복지를 높이려고 세워졌어요.

sentences.text: Lakon perang itu diawali suara pemboman yang membuat penonton terkejut.
sentences.en: The war play opens with the sound of bombing that startles the audience.
sentences.ko: 그 전쟁극은 관객을 놀라게 하는 폭격 소리로 시작해요.

sentences.text: Kakek Ayu masih ingat suara pemboman di lembah saat perang dulu.
sentences.en: Ayu's grandfather still remembers the sound of bombing in the valley during the war long ago.
sentences.ko: 아유의 할아버지는 옛 전쟁 때 골짜기에 울리던 폭격 소리를 아직 기억해요.

sentences.text: Malam penutupan festival teater berlangsung meriah.
sentences.en: The closing night of the theater festival was festive.
sentences.ko: 연극제 폐막 밤은 성대하게 열렸어요.

sentences.text: Warga kecewa dengan penutupan jalan ke kota akibat longsor.
sentences.en: The villagers were disappointed by the closure of the road to town due to a landslide.
sentences.ko: 주민들은 산사태로 시내 가는 길이 막혀 실망했어요.

sentences.text: Gedung teater itu adalah peninggalan zaman Belanda yang masih kokoh.
sentences.en: The theater building is a sturdy relic from the Dutch era.
sentences.ko: 그 극장 건물은 아직 튼튼한 네덜란드 시대의 유산이에요.

sentences.text: Di dekat desa Ayu ada candi kecil peninggalan kerajaan kuno.
sentences.en: Near Ayu's village there is a small temple left by an ancient kingdom.
sentences.ko: 아유네 마을 근처에는 옛 왕국이 남긴 작은 사원이 있어요.

sentences.text: Warga menolak rencana penghancuran gedung teater tua itu.
sentences.en: Residents opposed the plan to demolish the old theater building.
sentences.ko: 주민들은 그 오래된 극장을 허무는 계획에 반대했어요.

sentences.text: Warga khawatir tambang baru akan menyebabkan penghancuran hutan di lereng gunung.
sentences.en: The villagers worry the new mine will cause the destruction of the forest on the mountain slope.
sentences.ko: 주민들은 새 광산 때문에 산비탈 숲이 파괴될까 걱정해요.

sentences.text: Drama sejarah itu berlatar kota pelabuhan yang penuh bordil dan kedai minuman.
sentences.en: The historical drama is set in a port town full of brothels and taverns.
sentences.ko: 그 역사극은 사창가와 주점이 가득한 항구 도시가 배경이에요.

sentences.text: Dalam buku sejarah desa, Ayu membaca bahwa dulu ada bordil di dekat perkebunan Belanda.
sentences.en: In the village history book, Ayu reads that there was once a brothel near the Dutch plantation.
sentences.ko: 마을 역사책에서 아유는 옛날 네덜란드 농장 근처에 사창가가 있었다는 걸 읽어요.

sentences.text: Eko mengajarkan etika panggung kepada pemain baru, misalnya datang tepat waktu.
sentences.en: Eko teaches stage etiquette to new actors, such as arriving on time.
sentences.ko: 에코는 신인 배우들에게 시간 지키기 같은 무대 예절을 가르쳐요.

sentences.text: Para pemandu gunung punya etika untuk tidak meninggalkan sampah di jalur pendakian.
sentences.en: Mountain guides have an ethic of not leaving trash on hiking trails.
sentences.ko: 산악 가이드들은 등산로에 쓰레기를 남기지 않는다는 윤리가 있어요.

sentences.text: Dalam drama komedi itu, nelayan memamerkan tangkapan ikan yang ternyata palsu.
sentences.en: In the comedy, a fisherman shows off a catch of fish that turns out to be fake.
sentences.ko: 그 코미디에서 어부는 알고 보니 가짜인 물고기를 자랑해요.

sentences.text: Paman Ayu pulang dari danau membawa tangkapan ikan mas yang besar.
sentences.en: Ayu's uncle came back from the lake with a big catch of carp.
sentences.ko: 아유의 삼촌은 호수에서 큰 잉어를 잡아 돌아왔어요.

sentences.text: Lakon itu mengisahkan penyebaran kabar bohong di sebuah kampung kecil.
sentences.en: The play tells of the spread of a false rumor in a small village.
sentences.ko: 그 연극은 작은 마을에 거짓 소문이 퍼지는 이야기예요.

sentences.text: Petugas kesehatan berusaha mencegah penyebaran demam berdarah di desa.
sentences.en: Health workers are trying to prevent the spread of dengue fever in the village.
sentences.ko: 보건 요원들이 마을에 뎅기열이 퍼지는 걸 막으려고 애써요.

sentences.text: Para pemain berlatih di bekas barak tentara yang dijadikan studio.
sentences.en: The actors rehearse in a former army barracks turned into a studio.
sentences.ko: 배우들은 스튜디오로 바뀐 옛 군 막사에서 연습해요.

sentences.text: Saat longsor, warga mengungsi sementara ke barak darurat di lapangan.
sentences.en: During the landslide, residents temporarily evacuated to emergency barracks in the field.
sentences.ko: 산사태 때 주민들은 운동장의 임시 막사로 잠시 대피했어요.

sentences.text: Akhirnya perselisihan antara Eko dan penulis naskah selesai dengan damai.
sentences.en: In the end, the dispute between Eko and the playwright was settled peacefully.
sentences.ko: 결국 에코와 극작가 사이의 갈등은 평화롭게 끝났어요.

sentences.text: Tetua desa menyelesaikan perselisihan soal batas kebun antara dua keluarga.
sentences.en: The village elders settled the dispute over garden boundaries between two families.
sentences.ko: 마을 원로들이 두 집안의 밭 경계 다툼을 해결했어요.

sentences.text: Dalam drama itu, Eko berperan sebagai kanselir yang licik.
sentences.en: In the play, Eko plays a cunning chancellor.
sentences.ko: 그 연극에서 에코는 교활한 재상 역을 맡아요.

sentences.text: Di televisi warung, Ayu menonton berita tentang kanselir baru di sebuah negara Eropa.
sentences.en: On the stall's television, Ayu watches news about a new chancellor in a European country.
sentences.ko: 아유는 가게 텔레비전에서 어느 유럽 나라의 새 총리 소식을 봐요.
